item.title: Muslims In Malaysia To Begin Fasting Thursday
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR, Feb 17 (Bernama) — Muslims in Malaysia will begin fasting on Thursday, Feb 19, announced Keeper of the Rulers’ Seal Tan Sri Syed Danial Syed Ahmad. Syed Danial said the start date of the fast for states throughout Malaysia was set by the order of His Majesty Sultan Ibrahim, King of Malaysia, after the Rulers consented.
